one_liner: Reducto offers a REST document parsing/extraction API with free self-serve signup (free credits), bearer API keys, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API key created in Studio. Workload Identity (OIDC federated short-lived tokens) is also offered as an alternative. The local MCP server uses an OAuth device-code login only to obtain an API key.
access_notes: Free Studio account with free credits (draft: $150; homepage says 15,000 credits); API keys created self-serve in Studio.
blocker_notes: None; free credits allow building and testing.

evidence.quote: In the Studio sidebar, click **API Keys**, then **Create API Key**. Give it a name and copy the key.
Go to [studio.reducto.ai](https://studio.reducto.ai/) and sign up for a free account.
Get started free with 15,000 credits at https://studio.reducto.ai/.
Available in Python, Node.js, Go, and REST, with Studio for visual pipeline building.
[OpenAPI specification](https://reducto.ai/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 schema for the Reducto API.
The Reducto MCP server connects AI agents directly to Reducto.
